legacy_root.title: SBOM ingestion, validation, and query in the registry
legacy_root.question: Accept a published package's SBOM, validate it against the CycloneDX schema, store it against the version, and expose a query answering which packages in this registry contain component X at version Y.
legacy_root.answer: Ingest validates CycloneDX via JSON Schema and an independent structural check, stores PRESENT SBOMs against package@version, records missing SBOMs as SBOM-ABSENT, and answers component queries through an inverted index whose result set equals an independent brute-force scan of stored SBOMs. SUCCESS:IMP-0092
